## Visualizing the Measures of Central Tendency of the Poisson Distribution

This R script visualizes the measures of central tendency—mean, median, and mode—of the Poisson distribution. It computes the PMF and CDF for a given $\lambda$, then overlays vertical dashed lines to highlight the mean, median, and mode on each plot. The PMF plot shows the probability of discrete outcomes, while the CDF plot illustrates cumulative probabilities, providing a clear comparison of the distribution’s shape and its key central tendency measures.



```{r setup, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Parameter
lambda <- 5

# Support of Y
x <- 0:(lambda * 3)   # range wide enough to capture tail

# PMF and CDF
pmf <- dpois(x, lambda)
cdf <- ppois(x, lambda)

# Measures of central tendency
mean_val <- lambda
mode_val <- if (lambda %% 1 == 0) c(lambda - 1, lambda) else floor(lambda)

# Compute median numerically (first x where CDF >= 0.5)
median_val <- min(x[cdf >= 0.5])

# Put into data frame
df <- data.frame(x, pmf, cdf)

### Plot PMF
pmf_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x, pmf)) +
  geom_col(fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean_val, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_val, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mode_val, color = "purple", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Poisson(", lambda, ") PMF with Mean, Median, and Mode"),
    x = "k", y = "P(Y = k)"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = mean_val, y = max(pmf), label = "Mean", color = "red", vjust = -1) +
  annotate("text", x = median_val, y = max(pmf)/2, label = "Median", color = "black", vjust = -1) +
  annotate("text", x = mode_val[1], y = max(pmf)/1.5, label = "Mode", color = "purple", vjust = -1)

### Plot CDF
cdf_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x, cdf)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue") +
  geom_step() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean_val, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_val, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mode_val, color = "purple", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Poisson(", lambda, ") CDF with Mean, Median, and Mode"),
    x = "k", y = "P(Y ≤ k)"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = mean_val, y = 0.1, label = "Mean", color = "red", vjust = -1) +
  annotate("text", x = median_val, y = 0.3, label = "Median", color = "black", vjust = -1) +
  annotate("text", x = mode_val[1], y = 0.5, label = "Mode", color = "purple", vjust = -1)

# Display plots
print(pmf_plot)
print(cdf_plot)
```
